meta.description: Every Tuesday and Thursday at 9am, reads the Content Calendar Google Sheet and uses Claude to generate 3 unique posts (Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile). Posts automatically to all three platforms via their respective APIs. Logs all posts to the Post Log sheet.
